verdicts.evidence: VERDICT INVERSION on a quoted symbol padded with spaces. RECIPE: spec `- AC1 -> file:code/short.ts#" x"` (symbol ' x', 2 characters one of which is whitespace, trim -> 1), artifact 'const x = 1;', spec-check --json. Before: exit 1, 'names no usable symbol'; after: exit 0, 'linked' via content.includes(' x') — a pseudo-symbol made of one whitespace + one letter matches almost everywhere. Only the QUOTED form can carry whitespace and no test writes one: the trim is never discriminated.
